# kanban_board_membership_tool

> Attach an existing Task to a Kanban board, or remove one — the board-membership operations behind the board UI's "Add Task" picker.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `data` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=kanban_board_membership_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Attach an existing Task to a Kanban board, or remove one — the board-membership
operations behind the board UI's "Add Task" picker.

ACTIONS:
- add_task: put a task on a board (idempotent; optional position for card rank).
  Also syncs the task's custom_fields.gantt board pointer for same-tenant tasks.
- remove_task: take a task off a board (idempotent; clears the gantt pointer it set).

ACCESS: the caller needs UPDATE access to the board (owner, editor share, or
capability) and READ visibility of the task — cross-tenant shared tasks included,
so a provider can run other tenants' work on their own board.

NOTE: a task whose status maps to no board column renders on no lane. Check the
board's columns' status_mappings if an attached card does not appear.

This tool does NOT create tasks (general_crud_tool does) or change task status
(apply_status_tool does).

EXAMPLES:
{action: "add_task", kanban_board_id: 10, task_id: 3255}
{action: "add_task", kanban_board_id: 10, task_id: 3255, position: 4.5}
{action: "remove_task", kanban_board_id: 10, task_id: 3255}

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | string | yes | One of: add_task, remove_task. |
| `kanban_board_id` | integer | yes | The board to operate on (caller needs UPDATE access) |
| `task_id` | integer | yes | The task to attach/detach (caller needs READ visibility; cross-tenant shares resolve) |
| `position` | number | no | add_task only: card rank on the board (float; omitted = end of board) |
